Self-hosted cubing.js library bundle

Versions: {"cubing": "0.65.1", "esbuild": "0.28.2", "random-uint-below": "3.3.0", "three": "0.170.0"}

Library source: https://github.com/cubing/cubing.js/tree/c2d0a2fcdd9f0ed63ef8cdfc6ac30b497b727459
Published source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/cubing/-/cubing-0.65.1.tgz
Cubing.js is used under MPL-2.0, one of its dual-license options. Original library source is unmodified; this distribution is bundled and minified with esbuild.
Other bundled packages: Three.js (MIT), random-uint-below (Unlicense/public domain). Preserve associated LICENSE files and generated .LEGAL.txt notices.

Build settings: bundle=true, splitting=true, format=esm, platform=browser, target=es2022, minify=true, legalComments=linked.
Entry exports randomScrambleForEvent, puzzles, and ExperimentalSVGAnimator. Direct SVG drawing replaces the deferred TwistyPlayer custom element. Worker startup prioritizes the documented esbuild compatibility path, via setSearchDebug.
Copy this whole directory with its relative chunks layout intact. No external runtime package imports.
